info.title: API.SH: Rozetka
info.description: The Rozetka API from API.SH: public Rozetka data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

Rozetka's full category tree (every department and its categories with ids and links), or one branch when `id` is given. Category ids work with the category and search endpoints.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

parameters.description: Return only this category and its subcategories.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: Rozetka category listing with every filter
get.description:
Products in a Rozetka category, with every filter the category page has (brand, seller, condition, price and all specification filters), sorted like the site. Pass a category id or a category link (filters in the link are applied). Each product has the same card as search. The answer lists every filter group with option values and counts (`filter` tokens to pass back as `filters`), the chosen filters, sort options, the category and its subcategories, the category's product count and the matching count. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/rozetka-category

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Category id (the number after /c in a link) or a rozetka.com.ua category link.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Reviews of a Rozetka product: rating, date, text, pros, cons, verified-buyer flag, votes, photos, the variant bought (seller, colour, memory...) and replies (Rozetka staff and sellers by name; customers as first name and initial in `author` and by the name the page shows in `author_name`). The summary has the review count, buyer-review count, average rating, the count per star, and photo/video counts. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/rozetka-reviews

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Order or subset: newest (default), buyers only, with photos or video, most helpful.

parameters.name: rating
parameters.description: Only reviews with this many stars.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Search Rozetka (Ukraine) like the site's search box, with every filter the results offer. Each product: id, title, link, brand, price and old price in UAH, discount, USD price, availability, condition, rating and review count, short spec line, category, seller, label, images, variants (memory, colour...), tags and `raw`. The answer also lists the matching categories with counts and the filter groups with each option's `filter` token (pass tokens back joined with `;` as `filters`). The site shows at most 1,000 results (17 pages of 60). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/rozetka-search

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description: Filter tokens from a previous answer's `filters[].options[].filter`, joined with `;`, e.g. `producer:apple;seller:rozetka`. Several values of one filter: `producer:apple,samsung`.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Limit to one category id from `categories`, e.g. 80003.

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: Language of titles and labels (default ua).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A Rozetka marketplace seller: name, link, description, working hours, business phone when listed, logo, type, status, minimum order, stars, rank and vote counts, active since, and the rating breakdown (excellent to worst marks, average call-back, dispatch and delivery times, manager, convenience and delivery stars over 30 days, 180 days and all time).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/rozetka-seller

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Seller name from its link (rozetka.com.ua/seller/<name>/) or the link itself.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Products sold by one Rozetka seller, with the seller page's filters and sorts. Same product card and filter groups as the category endpoint. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/rozetka-seller-products

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
